### Borea v0.6.0-dev.4: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.6.0 before it is released.
It is not for users.
For normal use, stay on v0.5.2.
It builds on v0.6.0-dev.3, and the list below covers only what changed since that build.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### What you see on the next KSA build

The next KSA build changes the format of the part files.
On that build, the 3D preview of a vehicle, the pictures in Discover and the automatic cover of a share pause until a Borea update supports the new part format.
Borea tells you so where each of them would show, and everything else works as before.

#### Please test these first

- The preview, the pictures and the cover on KSA 2026.10.25.5707.
  Open the 3D preview of a vehicle, look at the vehicle pictures in Discover, and share a vehicle up to its cover card.
  All three must work as on v0.6.0-dev.3.
- A save shared end to end.
  Share a save through every step until the share is done.
  Tell us about each step that stops or shows a message you did not expect.
- The mod proposal of a share.
  Share a vehicle with mods installed, among them a mod that only changes a part of another mod.
  Borea must propose the mods that the vehicle needs, and must not propose a mod only because it changes a part of another mod.
- Going back: after you tested, read "Before you go back to v0.5.2" in the notes of v0.6.0-dev.2, and then start v0.5.2 again.
  Nothing new to know since that build.

#### New since v0.6.0-dev.3

- When the part files of the game use the newer KSA part format, the 3D preview of a vehicle says that this KSA build uses a newer part format and that the 3D preview comes with the next Borea update.
  On that format, Discover draws and stores no new picture and keeps the pictures it has, and the cover card of a share says that no cover comes and still lets you add your own picture.
- Borea finds the part format from the part files of the build that the preview reads, also for a kept build, and not from the build number.
  A part file that cannot be opened while the game updates is read again on the next preview.
- A vehicle.xml whose root part names no part now shows the damaged message on the vehicle page instead of one box.
- A share stops with a clear message on a vehicle.xml or universe.xml with a layout that Borea does not know.
- When you share a vehicle, Borea no longer proposes a mod as needed only because that mod patches, extends or removes a part, character or body of another mod.
  Such a mod also no longer shows as a second provider of the same id in the share.
  A mod that replaces an asset still counts as a provider, so a share does not lose a mod that it needs.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on.
When v0.6.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
